checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: the browser gate runs Chromium, Firefox and WebKit at three widths (G-004)

impact_assessment.why: G-004 requires three engines but only Chromium was ever tested
impact_assessment.benefits: A rendering or overflow regression in Firefox or WebKit now fails the gate set
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the browser gate needs two engines installed in the Playwright cache; dependency: playwright-core already declared; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: A missing engine fails with the exact install command and is never skipped, all three pass today, composer and layout compared across engines

handoff.next: A2 needs a live model and the History or Evals panels with data are not screenshotted
handoff.evidence: test:browser passes in chromium firefox and webkit at 390 768 and 1440, composer height identical in all three, 12 of 12 gates in 10 seconds for the browser gate

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: light theme text contrast, a deeper accent for text and a darker faint colour

impact_assessment.why: A contrast check that measures real colours found two light theme pairs below 4.5 to 1 which axe had left as incomplete
impact_assessment.benefits: Every visible text pair in both themes meets WCAG AA
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI only, 1 file 8 lines; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Dark theme untouched, guard test passes, mutation check shows the new check catches a broken muted colour, light pairs reviewed

handoff.state: light contrast fix reviewed by the agent under G-010
handoff.next: finish then commit then land the scripts that measure contrast and the light theme shots
handoff.evidence: the new check went from 2 real failures to 0 across 18 scans and the dark theme pairs changed only by the known live data noise, light desktop pair compared by eye shows a crisper banner title and meta text with no layout change, mutation of the light muted colour is caught at 1.09 to 1

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Plan: the accessibility gate measures contrast itself in both themes on every panel, and ui-shots covers the light theme

impact_assessment.why: axe evaluated 11 of about 365 text elements for contrast and left the rest incomplete, so the gate said nothing about the light theme
impact_assessment.benefits: A real contrast regression in either theme fails the gate set
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the a11y gate scans 18 states and fails on any text pair under 4.5 to 1 or 3 to 1 for large text; dependency: Chromium; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Gradient backed text is skipped and said so, disabled controls are exempt as WCAG allows, a mutation of the light muted colour is caught

handoff.next: A2 needs a live model and states with data are only covered by screenshot review
handoff.evidence: the a11y gate runs 18 scans in 12 seconds and passes, it failed on two real light theme pairs before the fix and caught a mutated muted colour at 1.09 to 1, 12 of 12 gates

checkpoints.description: Plan [1/1] audit UI at 390/768/1440 vs G-007/G-008/G-010, fix concrete defects

G-008 duplicate control: header ⌘K palette button hidden when rail visible (>980px; mobile-only class). before/after shots/ at desktop+narrow viewed: desktop header no longer duplicates rail Command palette, no clipping/overlap/contrast change; narrow keeps ⌘K (rail hidden), unchanged. npm test 603/603.
12/12 gates passed (test 603/603, lint, typecheck, build, a11y, browser, compat); ui finish --reviewed; checklists: passed

[1/1] First-run hint: Open Settings must open the workspace on narrow widths (currently a dead click) and read as the primary action (accent border, full-contrast text); failing-first test; before/after shots incl. narrow after-click scenario

impact_assessment.why: G-008 one obvious primary action; on 390/768 the hint button changes a tab that is off-canvas, so nothing visible happens
impact_assessment.benefits: First-run users on narrow screens reach Settings; the hint action is legible
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: workspaceOpen set on click
impact_assessment.mitigation: unit test pins data-open; tokens only; full gate run

checkpoints.description: 12/12 gates passed. Before/after (shots/firstrun, 390/768/1440): before, Open Settings at 390 and 768 was a dead click (settingsVisibleAfterClick=false), after true at all three; button now full-contrast text with accent border, no clipping/overlap, contrast fine. Failing-first unit test added. checklists: passed

[1/1] Workspace overlay (<=980px) has no way back to the conversation: add mobile-only back bar + Escape closes it; Evals empty state shows literal backticks: render as code. Failing-first unit tests; before/after scenario shots at 390/768/1440

impact_assessment.why: G-004 usable at 390/768 and G-008 nothing unreachable: nothing ever calls setWorkspaceOpen(false), so the full-screen workspace is a trap on narrow screens
impact_assessment.benefits: Narrow users can leave Settings/Files/etc; stale raw markup removed
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Escape also closes workspace; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: workspaceOpen toggled
impact_assessment.mitigation: unit tests pin close button and Escape; desktop layout unchanged (bar is mobile-only); full gate run

checkpoints.description: 12/12 gates passed. Before/after shots/workspace-exit (390/768/1440): before the full-screen workspace had no exit at <=980px (composerReachableAfterOpen=false at 390 and 768); after true at all three, back bar legible, no clipping/overlap/horizontal scroll, desktop unchanged; Evals hint no longer shows raw backticks (dark+light viewed). 2 failing-first tests. checklists: passed
